principle: Art serves task. Improve useful behavior, finish and motion; never reproduce weak code or decorative metaphors.

references.idea: A button label changes from action to completion.
references.improve: Use a native button with idle, press, pending, success and retry states. Reserve label width; make the label swap short and legible. Remove physical housing decoration.

references.idea: A light arc communicates pending work.
references.improve: Add honest pending, complete and failure feedback with replay; use status text and a static reduced-motion state. Do not show made-up progress as real.

references.idea: A card expands the selected metric and reveals detail while neighbors yield space.
references.improve: Keep labels and values readable during resize, support tap and keyboard selection, stop motion when settled. No idle cycling after user input; use current clean palette.

references.idea: A share panel opens as a bottom sheet with snap positions and useful copy actions.
references.improve: Keep only the panel and its trigger, add focus return, Escape and button alternatives to drag; preserve content at small widths and make clipboard failure visible.

references.idea: A log panel filters sample events and pauses the stream.
references.improve: Keep severity filtering, replace curved unreadable lines with a crisp selectable event list and detail view. Stop ambient changes after input; add keyboard selection, empty results and readable phone layout.

references.idea: A pipeline panel selects execution stages and inspects related logs.
references.improve: Extract stage selection, failure detail and retry into a compact panel. Remove oscilloscope housing and alert dialogs; make retry update consistent sample state, add keyboard access and precise reveal timing.

references.idea: A code diff accepts or rejects one hunk.
references.improve: Keep hunk decisions, add a clear pending/resolved state and undo, readable line numbers, horizontal code scrolling, keyboard focus and restrained accept/reject motion.

issueBriefs.task: Latency chart: a chart card for a service dashboard that selects a time range and reveals request latency at a chosen point.
Pipeline panel: a status panel for a build tool that expands a failed step, shows its log and retries it in a local demo.
Log viewer: a compact panel for a developer tool that filters sample events by severity and opens the selected event details.
Request loader: a loader for a content panel that moves from pending to loaded or failed, with a retry action and stable layout.
Import progress: a loader for a file tool that shows named stages, lets someone cancel and ends with a clear completion state.
